subject: DEFINE directive
notes: cite.py --check 7.3.11.4 "If literal-1 is specified, compilation-variable-name-1 references literal-1." -> OK GR8. Every literal category binds its literal: numeric (p1b N=3, F=1.5), alphanumeric (S="ABC"), national (u1 N"AB"), boolean (u1 B"10"), hexadecimal-alphanumeric (u1 X"41" = "A"); a floating-point literal is refused per §7.3.3 SR10 (n9). The numeric case is pinned by Define_SingleFractionLiteral_KeepsValue; no DEFINE test pins the non-numeric categories - test-needed. || editions (adjudicator): 2002, 2014, 2023 - §7.3 compiler-directive facility; ISO/IEC 1989:2023 Annex E lists no change to §7.3.11 against 2014 (the 2002 introduction is not stated in the 2023 text itself; below 2002 the directive is COBOL0900)
